outcome: incidence of obstetric codes requiring rapid response team activation
cohort: Peripartum women hospitalized between January 2014 and May 2018
finding: Rapid response team activation was required more commonly in C77 than in CO or CB, with rapid response time and decision-to-delivery intervals, low mortality, but one-third of parturients experiencing major morbidities.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean delivery was performed for 57% of obstetric emergencies.
